headline: Tejas Networks allots 67,813 securities under ESOP and RSU

modes.bear: Increases the total share count, causing minor equity dilution for existing shareholders.
modes.bull: ESOP allotments align employee interests with shareholder growth, signalling internal confidence.
modes.simple: Companies often reward employees with shares. Tejas Networks just issued a small batch of new shares to its staff, slightly increasing the total number of shares in the market.

summary: Tejas Networks Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges about the allotment of 67,813 securities on November 27, 2026. This allotment was executed pursuant to the company's Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) and Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) schemes. Such routine allotments marginally increase the total paid-up equity base of the company. For retail investors, tracking share dilutions from stock-based compensation is important for monitoring long-term equity value.
why_it_matters: Slight equity dilution from latest ESOP allotment.
